response.original_title: [[FAQS@]] How to Add Another Room to Your Celebrity Cruise booking?
response.overview: To add an extra room to an existing Celebrity Cruise reservation, call Celebrity Cruise at +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +61-1800-009-384 contact your travel advisor, +1-866-829-1280 as new cabins cannot be added to an existing booking online. Reach out directly by phone. If you booked through a travel agent or the Celebrity Vacation Club, +1-866-829-1280 your agent must make the changes for you. To add an additional room to an existing Celebrity Cruise reservation, +1-866-829-1280 you must book a separate new stateroom and link it to your current itinerary by calling Celebrity Cruise +1-866-829-1280 or your travel agent. You cannot directly add an extra physical stateroom onto an existing reservation online. You can book a separate stateroom +1-866-829-1280 online or have an agent do it. Contact Celebrity Cruise directly at +1-866-829-1280 (or your original travel agent) to ensure the new room is properly linked to your current booking.
